Yesterday was my first day back after the conference and I am still catching up on a mountain of emails, most of which are about parking permits, a vendor demonstration of a new electronic health record add-on, and the annual fire safety training that everyone ignores until the last day. The weather turned cold, my car needed an oil change, and I realized I had not eaten lunch until nearly four in the afternoon. A neighbor told me about a restaurant that serves excellent dumplings and I plan to try it this weekend with my family, assuming the babysitter is free and the traffic on the highway is not terrible because of the construction. In the meantime the actual test: moderate obstruction by FEV1 with a low FVC, lung volumes were not done so restriction cannot be evaluated, and there was a significant bronchodilator response; DLCO was not done. I also still need to find my reading glasses, return a library book that is now two weeks overdue, and reply to the committee about the schedule for next quarter's grand rounds before the weekend arrives.
